prompt: Design drug candidates for KRAS G12C mutant protein for cancer therapy. I need 2 molecules with high binding affinity. Use device cuda:1 if available.

assertions.text: produces_sdf_files: Should produce at least 1 SDF file containing candidate molecules
produces_visualizations: Should produce molecular visualizations (PNG images)
produces_markdown_report: Should produce a markdown report with target introduction, methods, and results
identifies_kras_g12c_pocket: Should identify the mutant-specific pocket (switch-II pocket) for KRAS G12C
report_mentions_sotorasib_adagrasib: Report should mention known KRAS G12C inhibitors (sotorasib/adagrasib)
